decision.reason: Every generated-step full-vocabulary logit vector was bit-exact between the stable adaptive-prefetch path and the Python exact-expert reference. Identical logits plus the identical seeded sampler imply identical categorical distributions; every sampled token also matched. Forced misses and no-prefetch stable paths matched in the separate fixed-seed check.
